svg.text: Brain research: label purge, realized-return IC, and source-price NAV
489 five-session observations | 2016-12-27 signal to 2026-09-22 exit | exploratory, not execution certification
A Cached-Yahoo NAV: conditional static-ticker identity, gross
Next-session close entry; intended Top50 chosen before future quotes; failed entries remain cash.
Formal full-period NAV: WITHHELD. Duplicate SID-to-ticker identities remain unresolved.
Restricted equal-weight book has one unpriced exit: no full-period NAV, no gap deletion or zero-loss fill.
B Return IC across label horizons
Daily cross-sectional ranks on observed corpus-close pairs
fund / HGB: outcome is IC5; only embargo changes
Horizon IC uses overlapping observed labels; no iid significance claim. Models were selected on the displayed period.
Yahoo chart and corpus IC are separate price definitions. Teacher contribution is not proof of independent alpha.
